help.title: Help
help.intro: Kura keeps your Obsidian vaults in sync across your devices, on your organisation's server. Start with the plugin; the questions below cover the rest.

obsidian.title: Sync with Obsidian
obsidian.lead: Kura Sync is the Obsidian plugin that syncs a vault with this server. It is not in Obsidian's plugin catalogue: install it from here, once per device.
obsidian.notBundled: This server was built without the plugin. Ask your administrator for the Kura Sync files.
obsidian.noLink: This server does not say how the plugin signs in: set it up by hand, below.
obsidian.code: Obsidian shows what the link sets: accept, then approve the code it shows, with the account you use here.
obsidian.byHand: Set it up by hand instead
obsidian.byHandThen: In Obsidian, paste both in Settings › Kura Sync, select Sign in, then choose the vault.

download.title: Download the plugin
download.body: On this device, download the file below.

unzip.title: Unzip it into your vault
unzip.body: Unzip it into the plugins folder of your Obsidian vault, so that you get this folder. .obsidian is hidden: show hidden files (on a Mac, ⌘ ⇧ . in Finder), and create plugins if it is not there.

enable.title: Turn it on in Obsidian
enable.body: Open the vault in Obsidian, then Settings › Community plugins. Turn off Restricted mode if asked, then turn on Kura Sync. Not listed? Select the reload icon next to Installed plugins.

connect.title: Connect a vault
connect.body: From this device, with Obsidian installed, select the vault to sync.

androidExtract.title: Extract the file
androidExtract.body: In Files (by Google), open Downloads, touch kura-sync.zip, then Extract. You get a folder named weebo-kura.

androidMove.title: Move it into your vault
androidMove.body: In the Files settings, turn on Show hidden files. Then move the weebo-kura folder into your vault's plugins folder (vaults are usually under Documents). Create plugins if it is not there.

iosIcloud.title: Keep the vault in iCloud Drive
iosIcloud.body: The Files app does not show the hidden .obsidian folder, so the plugin goes in from a computer. In Obsidian on the iPhone or iPad, create the vault with "Store in iCloud" on, or move it there.

iosCopy.title: On a computer, download the plugin
iosCopy.body: Open this page on a Mac or PC signed in to the same iCloud account, and download the file there.

iosPlace.title: Copy it into the vault, in iCloud Drive
iosPlace.body: Unzip it, then copy the weebo-kura folder here, in iCloud Drive (on a Mac, ⌘ ⇧ . in Finder shows .obsidian). Wait for iCloud to send it to the phone.

reader.title: How do I read a vault without Obsidian?
reader.p1: The sidebar lists the vaults shared with you. Open one: its Notes tab browses its folders and reads its notes here; each note has its history.
reader.p2: Search is offered when the tenant turns it on. A manager can open only some folders of a vault to you: you then see those folders and nothing else.

roles.title: What can my role do?
roles.viewer: reads the vault, in Obsidian or here; changes made on its devices are not uploaded.
roles.editor: reads and writes: its devices sync both ways.
roles.manager: an editor who also decides who opens the vault and creates its access keys.
roles.folders: A viewer can be limited to some folders: they read those in the browser only.

devices.title: I lost a device, or I am on a shared computer
devices.p1: Each browser and each Obsidian that signs in is a device. My devices lists yours, with when each was last seen.
devices.p2: Lost a laptop or a phone? Revoke it there: it stops at its next request. On a shared computer, leave "Stay signed in" unchecked, and sign out when done: signing out revokes this browser.

trouble.title: The plugin does not appear, or the link does nothing
trouble.p1: Not in Community plugins: check that the folder is .obsidian/plugins/weebo-kura (not a folder inside it) and holds main.js and manifest.json, then select the reload icon next to Installed plugins.
trouble.p2: The link does nothing: Obsidian must be installed on this device, and Kura Sync turned on in the vault Obsidian opens. With several vaults, open the right one first.
trouble.p3: The status bar says "sign in": open Settings › Kura Sync and select Sign in.

manage.title: I manage a vault or a tenant
manage.access: Who opens a vault: a group of your identity provider or one person, as viewer, editor or manager, on the whole vault or some folders.
manage.keys: Access keys for scripts and agents: limited to folders, read or write, to addresses, and to a lifetime. The secret is shown once.
manage.vaults: Tenant owners and admins create vaults and delete the ones made here; vaults declared in configuration change there.
manage.devices: On a vault's overview, the devices that sync it: when each last caught up, how many notes it is behind, and its last push. A manager sees everyone's, a member their own.
manage.notifications: Send a tenant's events (a vault changed, a key about to expire, a device revoked…) to a webhook, signed with a secret you can rotate.
